Chapter 6356: Lostmetal Devourment

Chapter 6356: Lostmetal Devourment

The palm strike seemed to have been delivered by an immortal. Its signature aura was above the primal level.

Although the duo didn’t hold back, the palm strike easily obliterated the laws of the two attacks.

They summoned their treasures and utilized their best defensive techniques to no avail. Both were sent flying through mountains.

Their tough body had cracks everywhere with pulverized flesh and gushing blood. This made the difference between the imperial and primal realm clear to everyone.

Moreover, her palm strike left them speechless. Its aura made them want to kneel on the ground since it was reminiscent of the progenitor.

Boundless Frontier was a variation of the Desolate Palm technique. Absolute Ancestor could perform the same strike but to a lesser effect despite being far stronger. She was a descendant who didn’t have the privilege of meeting Desolate Ancestor or witnessing the palm strike

Driedtree, on the other hand, saw it in action before. Thus, her technique was far more refined and immaculate.

“Ooo-” The viper roared at the incoming slash. Its scales and body were as tough as the finest metals.

Alas, the saber made out of a branch decapitated all three heads, tossing them into the air and causing a rain of blood.

Her withering power entered its body, decimating its vitality, soul, and life force. The viper became a dried corpse in a split second.

“Nooo!” Goldclad and Lostmetal roared furiously.

Everyone knew their grand dao and merit laws came from observing the viper. It had followed them for years and was no different than a family member.

Rage drove them to muster all of their might. Goldclad’s dao covered his anima tree, adding a layer of gold.

It gained toughness and sharpness, turning into a weapon. On the other hand, Lostmetal’s anima tree started shedding and appeared to be withering. Nevertheless, it gained an aura of death, turning it into a primal beast capable of swallowing all lives.

“Daosmelt and Lostmetal Devourment!” An ancestor shouted the names of the supreme grand dao. The emperors used their ultimate technique without holding back.

“Crackle!” Meanwhile, lightning bolts detonated above - the main source of Driedtree Emperor’s concern.

“Desolate Wilt!” She utilized her supreme grand dao as well.  Desolate force swept through the region, nearly flipping the ground over.

The dragon dao turned into a palm, preparing to devastate everything in its wake. It called the power of the land and became unstoppable.

Her dao originated from the guidance of Desolate Ancestor. It focused on Desolate Palm as the foundation, molding its power into her primary dao.

Therefore, Desolate Frontier turned dark, seemingly harmonizing with her world-ending palm strike.

Disciples were scared out of their mind and trembled on the ground. Some even peed in their pants.

“Bam!” The duo’s ultimates stood no chance against the palm strike.

Both were reduced to blood, only their true fate and anima tree were left. However, she didn’t show mercy and added power to her Desolate Wilt.

“Buzz.” The two anima trees showed signs of withering despite being the toughest thing in cultivation. Their destruction was only a matter of time.

“!!!” Crimson Virtue and Solar Monarch didn’t expect her to be merciless and decisive, going as far as killing the two emperors.
